_: The bookmark icons, and the names they answer to.
Placeholders until the real set arrives. Replacing them is this file and
nothing else: the player reads it at startup and never hard-codes a glyph.
Each entry needs an `id` and a `name`. The id is what gets stored against a
bookmark, so once one is in use, keep it -- renaming an id orphans every
bookmark that used it, while renaming a `name` costs nothing.
"src": "icons/star.svg"  a file under public/, drawn as an image
`keywords` are extra words the search box should match, for when the name
is not what someone would type. The search looks at the name, the id, and
these, so "star" finds Star, Gold star and Sparkle.
The positions below are GENERATED from the tags folder.
Their id is the number in the filename, so it survives a re-run and a
rename; their name and keywords are the bracketed name and the comma list.
Re-make them with scratchpad/mkicons.mjs after changing tags/ -- editing a
pos- entry by hand here will be overwritten.
